chapters.title: All your agents. One local view.
chapters.subtitle: Follow multiple projects and agent tools from the same dashboard.
chapters.proof: Native Mac recording · fictional sessions · 2.0 development build
chapters.en: See working, quiet and CI-waiting sessions across agent tools and projects.
chapters.ko: 여러 도구와 프로젝트에서 작업 중·유휴·CI 대기 중인 세션을 함께 봅니다.
chapters.ja: 複数のツールやプロジェクトの作業中・待機・CI待ちをまとめて確認。

chapters.title: A dashboard that fits your desk.
chapters.subtitle: Use a tablet as a dedicated view while you keep working on your computer.
chapters.proof: Native iPad Simulator recording · Default dashboard · fictional sessions
chapters.en: The tablet keeps the roster, activity timeline and usage windows in view.
chapters.ko: 태블릿에서 세션 목록·활동 타임라인·사용량 창을 한눈에 확인합니다.
chapters.ja: タブレットでセッション一覧、活動履歴、使用量の期間枠を確認。

chapters.title: Follow the work, session by session.
chapters.subtitle: Read the project, model and activity. Keep CI waiting separate from a request for you.
chapters.proof: Native Mac close-ups · actual production key renderer · sample state
chapters.en: Select a session to focus its timeline. CI waiting does not mean approval is needed.
chapters.ko: 세션을 선택하면 해당 타임라인에 집중합니다. CI 대기와 사용자 승인 대기는 다릅니다.
chapters.ja: セッションを選んで履歴を絞り込み。CI待ちとユーザー承認待ちは別の状態です。

chapters.title: See who is waiting on whom.
chapters.subtitle: Collaboration Beta shows observed messages, explicit reply requests and related sessions.
chapters.proof: Native Mac collaboration graph · fictional observed messages · enlarged crop
chapters.en: Explicit reply requests have a waiting timer. A one-way notification stays a notification.
chapters.ko: 답변 요청에는 대기 시간이 표시됩니다. 단순 알림을 응답 대기로 취급하지 않습니다.
chapters.ja: 明示的な返信依頼には待機時間を表示。一方通行の通知とは区別します。

chapters.title: Know your remaining room to work.
chapters.subtitle: Inspect reported limit windows, reset times and freshness; keep missing readings unknown.
chapters.proof: Native iPhone usage panel + production Stream Deck+ encoder renderer · sample quota
chapters.en: Reported usage windows and reset times appear on the dashboard and dedicated dials.
chapters.ko: 보고된 사용량 창과 초기화 시각을 대시보드와 전용 다이얼에서 확인합니다.
chapters.ja: 取得できた使用量枠とリセット時刻をダッシュボードや専用ダイヤルで確認。

chapters.title: Read the request. Make the actual choice.
chapters.subtitle: Choose the offered option, review the command and allow one local run.
chapters.proof: Native iPhone Simulator · real OpenCode SDK execution · fictional workspace · original speed
chapters.en: Original question → choice → one-time permission → resumed work. This is the real local control path.
chapters.ko: 원문 질문 → 선택 → 일회성 승인 → 작업 재개. 실제 로컬 제어 경로입니다.
chapters.ja: 元の質問 → 選択 → 一度だけ許可 → 作業再開。実際のローカル制御経路です。

chapters.title: Give each controller a useful job.
chapters.subtitle: Session keys, original choices and usage dials; Ulanzi uses the same session layout engine.
chapters.proof: Production key and Ulanzi layout renderers · fictional state · enlarged, not hardware footage
chapters.en: Keys surface sessions and supported answers. Dials keep usage accessible without taking over every key.
chapters.ko: 키는 세션과 지원되는 응답을, 다이얼은 사용량을 담당합니다. 기기의 입력 능력에 맞춥니다.
chapters.ja: キーはセッションと対応する回答、ダイヤルは使用量。機器の入力能力に合わせます。

chapters.title: Use the controls your agent actually offers.
chapters.subtitle: Voice input on deliverable sessions; model and thinking settings from a connected Gateway.
chapters.proof: Production Ulanzi detail renderer · fictional Gateway state · no voice or settings command executed
chapters.en: Available controls follow the connected agent. Unsupported sessions remain observation-only.
chapters.ko: 연결된 에이전트가 지원하는 조작만 제공합니다. 지원하지 않는 세션은 관찰 전용입니다.
chapters.ja: 接続先が対応する操作だけを表示。未対応のセッションは参照専用です。

chapters.title: Review the result, not just a green light.
chapters.subtitle: Open a task, inspect the AI estimate, its recorded reasoning and what it says is missing.
chapters.proof: Actual APME product UI · fictional task and sample judge result · still capture
chapters.en: Task review separates an AI estimate from verified evidence and from your own assessment.
chapters.ko: 작업 평가는 AI 추정·기록된 근거·사용자의 판단을 구분합니다.
chapters.ja: 作業レビューではAIの推定、記録された根拠、自分の評価を区別します。

chapters.title: Go back to the evidence.
chapters.subtitle: Revisit the original request, archived reply and tool output, then record your own assessment.
chapters.proof: Actual APME product UI · fictional archived evidence · still capture
chapters.en: Read the original request, reply and tool evidence. Your correction stays separate from the AI judgement.
chapters.ko: 원문 요청·응답·도구 기록을 검토합니다. 사용자 평가는 AI 판단과 별도로 보존됩니다.
chapters.ja: 元の依頼、応答、ツール記録を確認。ユーザー評価はAI判断と別に保存します。

chapters.title: A quiet view on e-ink.
chapters.subtitle: Readable sessions and usage on Android readers and dedicated paper displays.
chapters.proof: Native Android screenshot + firmware host renderer · fictional data · not new physical testing
chapters.en: E-ink prioritizes readable status. Controls depend on the device and the connected agent's capabilities.
chapters.ko: 전자잉크에서는 읽기 쉬운 상태가 우선입니다. 조작은 기기와 연결된 에이전트의 능력에 따릅니다.
chapters.ja: 電子ペーパーでは読みやすい状態表示を優先。操作は機器と接続先の対応範囲に従います。

chapters.title: Small screens show the useful essentials.
chapters.subtitle: Compact IPS and AMOLED panels show focused status; LED matrices remain glance displays.
chapters.proof: Actual firmware host renders · fictional data · enlarged pixels, not physical captures
chapters.en: A small display does not promise a full controller. Its useful status and input scope are device-specific.
chapters.ko: 작은 화면에 완전한 컨트롤러를 약속하지 않습니다. 유용한 상태와 입력 범위만 제공합니다.
chapters.ja: 小さな画面に全操作は詰め込みません。各機器に役立つ状態と入力範囲を提供します。

chapters.title: A signal you can see from across the desk.
chapters.subtitle: LED matrices show glanceable activity and usage within their small pixel grids.
chapters.proof: Historical physical-device photographs · September 28, 2026 · retained reference media
chapters.en: Timebox, iDotMatrix and TC001 are glance displays; they do not promise touch approval.
chapters.ko: Timebox·iDotMatrix·TC001은 상태를 훑어보는 화면입니다. 터치 승인을 약속하지 않습니다.
chapters.ja: Timebox・iDotMatrix・TC001は一目で状態を見る画面。タッチ承認は提供しません。

chapters.title: Start with the screen you already have.
chapters.subtitle: Use the Mac app or terminal, then pair the displays and controllers that fit your setup.
chapters.proof: Terminal reference capture + historical desk photograph, September 28, 2026
chapters.en: The local hub connects your own screens. Additional hardware is optional.
chapters.ko: 로컬 허브에 이미 가진 화면을 연결합니다. 추가 하드웨어는 선택입니다.
chapters.ja: 手持ちの画面をローカルハブに接続。追加のハードウェアは必須ではありません。
